# AgentDFIR

> Open-source digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) framework for AI agents. Collects, preserves, reconstructs and investigates activity from Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI and other agentic AI tools. Core principle: AI-generated text is never automatically treated as factual evidence of execution — every action is classified REQUESTED / REPORTED / OBSERVED / CORROBORATED / CONTRADICTED / UNKNOWN.

Status: released (v4.0.0, 2026-10-25). v4.0 extends collection from coding agents to every AI evidence source: `collect --image` reads E01 / raw / split / VHD / VHDX / VMDK images directly (MBR/GPT; NTFS, ext2/3/4, FAT12/16/32, exFAT; pure Go, nothing mounted; encrypted and unsupported volumes named, never skipped); `collect --ai-export` seals ChatGPT, Claude.ai, DeepSeek and Gemini (Takeout) account exports and imports UFDR layouts (an export is the provider's record: its tool calls are never CONFIRMED against the machine); `--include-browser` (opt-in only) adds AI-service visits from browser history, never content; Continue (full sessions) and Windsurf (rules, memories, MCP; Cascade stores sealed, content UNSUPPORTED) collectors; second witnesses from raw Windows .evtx (Sysmon, Security 4688, PowerShell 4104), DNS, web proxy, auth.log/journald, Kubernetes, GitHub/GitLab and object-storage audit logs (partial witnesses corroborate, never contradict); `gaps` (what the case does not show, what to collect next), `lineage` (evidence-backed human → agent → tool → process → destination graph; text/json/mermaid/dot), `correlate-cases` (what verified cases share); `extensions` (IDE extensions, agent plugins, skills); `report --format rsmf` and `export --production` (RSMF 2.0, production sets, derivative-only redaction; structural validation, no admissibility claim); `benchmark` (synthetic: 100% precision/recall on its own labeled fixtures — not real-world accuracy — 24/24 tamper mutations detected, 0 dangling provenance references, 5/5 historical packages verify); an independent stdlib-only Python verifier and conformance fixtures for .adfir spec 0.2.1; `report accountability`, `export custody` and `selfcheck --offline`. Go module path: github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/v4 (commands, flags, exit codes and .adfir 0.2 packages unchanged). The explorer (`agentdfir serve`) is an investigation workbench: Sessions tab (one risk-sorted card per session with metadata and corroboration bar), attack chains (toxic combinations: ordered event sequences such as injection → self-modification → shell, matched in one session within a time window, 11 built-in, JSON-extensible), Coverage, Who did what (lineage), Second witness side-by-side, AI conversations, Extensions, Bookmarks and Compare cases (`serve --compare`) views, the investigation tree under every finding (steps in order and what led to each: prompt before, tool result consumed, spawn), whole-case search (events, findings, raw artifact bytes; Cmd/Ctrl+K command palette: fuzzy jump to any view, finding or conversation plus live evidence matches), and a hash-chained analyst case file (verdicts, pins, tags, notes) rendered into PDF/HTML reports. One command does the common case: `agentdfir run` = detect every installed agent → collect into one sealed package → analyze → open the browser explorer; install-and-run in one line — macOS/Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/efij/AgentDFIR/main/install.sh | sh && ~/.local/bin/agentdfir run`; Windows (x64/ARM64, PowerShell): `$env:AGENTDFIR_RUN=1; irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/efij/AgentDFIR/main/install.ps1 | iex`. Since v2.7: `agentdfir mitigate` turns findings into guardrails in the agents' own settings (Claude Code permissions + log-guard hook, Codex rules, Cursor CLI denies, MCP pins), planned first, backed up, ledgered and reversible; `agentdfir export` / `agentdfir open` move a case to another computer in one file. Since v3.0: `agentdfir hunt` checks a machine for eight known 2025–2026 incidents (Nx s1ngularity, Shai-Hulud 1 and 2, the keyv wave, SANDWORM_MODE, postmark-mcp, codexui-android, Amazon Q wiper) plus STIX 2.1 / MISP feeds, classifying each hit as OBSERVED / SEEN_IN_OUTPUT / MENTIONED; `agentdfir scan-repo` checks a repository before an AI agent opens it (committed SessionStart hooks, VS Code folderOpen tasks, project MCP servers, injected AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) with SARIF output and a GitHub Action; an offline decoder unwraps nested base64/gzip/hex/UTF-16LE payloads for the rules; `monitor --journal` makes transcripts tamper-evident. Supported products: Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Codex CLI and desktop app, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Copilot Chat for VS Code, Cline, Roo Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Aider, Warp, Continue (full parsers), plus Windsurf and Kiro configuration; 196 deterministic detections (111 built-in incl. 11 attack chains + 85 pack rules), 134 HIGH/CRITICAL of which 132 are mapped to MITRE ATLAS 5.6 / ATT&CK (28 ATLAS, 73 ATT&CK techniques; see detection-coverage.md), streaming analysis for multi-GB packages, signed product packs for adding new agents without code.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/): what AI agent forensics is and what AgentDFIR does
- [Claude Code Forensic Artifacts](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/claude-code-forensic-artifacts): artifact locations, JSONL schema, collection
- [Detection Coverage](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/detection-coverage.md): generated matrix of every built-in and pack rule → MITRE ATLAS (agentic techniques AML.T0080–T0110 included) and ATT&CK technique; `agentdfir rules list --packs rules --json`
- [Install](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/install.md): portable raw binaries (air-gap/USB; Windows x64 and ARM64), install.sh (macOS/Linux), install.ps1 (Windows), Homebrew tap, go install; SHA256 + Sigstore verification; why macOS Gatekeeper / Windows SmartScreen prompt on unsigned downloads and the one-step fix
- [Case Explorer](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/serve.md): agentdfir serve — local browser UI: sessions, attack chains, investigation tree, timeline scrubber, raw evidence, whole-case search, case notes, topology; loopback only
- [Attack Chains](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/attack-chains.md): toxic combinations — the 11 built-in chains, matching semantics, step predicates, writing *.chains.json packs
- [Container / CI Collection](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/container-ci-collection.md): collect --docker and --archive — containers, CI artifacts, support bundles, vendor exports
- [Disk Images](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/disk-images.md): collect --image — E01/raw/split/VHD/VHDX/VMDK, MBR/GPT, NTFS/ext2-4/FAT/exFAT, image-provenance.jsonl, what is not read and the mount-then-import route
- [AI-service Exports](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/ai-service-exports.md): collect --ai-export — ChatGPT, Claude.ai, DeepSeek, Gemini Takeout, UFDR layout import; evidence class, JSON Pointer provenance, coverage
- [Browser AI Sessions](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/browser-ai-sessions.md): opt-in --include-browser — AI-service visits from Chromium/Firefox/Safari history; only listed services kept, never conversation content
- [Continue and Windsurf](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/ai-ide-products.md): collectors, Continue session parsing, Windsurf rules/memories/MCP, Cascade UNSUPPORTED
- [Investigation layer](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/investigation-graph.md): agentdfir gaps, lineage and correlate-cases — schemas, edge bases, honest limits
- [v4 Detections](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/detection-v4.md): new agent-behaviour rules and chains, dedupe verdicts, what was not built and why
- [Extensions and Plugins](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/extensions-plugins.md): agentdfir extensions — IDE extension, agent plugin and skill inventory and heuristics
- [eDiscovery](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/ediscovery.md): report --format rsmf, export --production, derivative-only redaction
- [Benchmark](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/benchmark.md): agentdfir benchmark (synthetic) and the independent Python .adfir verifier
- [Instruction Provenance](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/provenance.md): who wrote each line of CLAUDE.md / rules / settings and whether it came from a tool result
- [Real-time Detection](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/realtime-detection.md): monitor --detect --alert — live sensor pushing findings to webhook/syslog/file
- [Endpoint Corroboration](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/endpoint-corroboration.md): auditd / Sysmon / raw .evtx / EDR exports, DNS / proxy / auth / journald / Kubernetes / Git-hosting / storage logs, and AWS CloudTrail / Azure Activity Log / GCP Cloud Audit Log exports for az/aws/gcloud commands, as a second witness — CORROBORATED vs CONTRADICTED tool calls, unlogged agent activity
- [MCP Audit](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/mcp-audit.md): read-only MCP server inventory + supply-chain findings across 9 agent hosts, baseline drift, gateway-log corroboration
- [MCP Forensics](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/mcp-forensics): MCP config and tool-activity investigation
- [Hunt](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/hunt.md): agentdfir hunt — was this machine hit by a known AI-agent or npm supply-chain incident; IOC packs, STIX 2.1 / MISP import, lockfile checks, evidence-window verdicts
- [Scan a repository](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/scan-repo.md): agentdfir scan-repo — committed agent hooks, folderOpen tasks, repo MCP servers and instruction injection, before an agent opens the folder; SARIF, GitHub Action, pre-commit
- [Offline payload decoding](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/decode.md): nested base64/base32/hex/gzip/zlib/bzip2/UTF-16LE decoding feeding every command rule
- [Accountability](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/accountability.md): agentdfir report accountability — for every consequential action, who asked (human prompt or tool result), what was allowed (permission state captured at that round), what the agent did (event, evidence state, witness, masked command, target) and whether it went beyond the instruction (deterministic gap codes, never "authorized"); md/json/html, JSON schema
- [Evidence authentication](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/evidence-authentication.md): how a case authenticates itself (seal chain, archived seals, SEAL.sig, anchors, custody hash chain) with reproduction commands for AgentDFIR and standard tools; US FRE 902(13)/902(14) context and ISO/IEC 27037 note; agentdfir export custody (chain-of-custody bundle + pre-filled certification template) and agentdfir case authorize; not legal advice, never "admissible"/"compliant"
- [Offline self-check](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/selfcheck.md): agentdfir selfcheck --offline — prove on your own machine that a collection + analysis opens no socket, spawns no process and writes only inside the case/state dirs; sandbox-exec (macOS) / unshare+strace (Linux) / in-process guard; levels kernel-enforced, traced, in-process; connectivity canary so a non-enforcing sandbox never passes
- [Mitigate](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/mitigate.md): agentdfir mitigate — guardrail packs, fix-now controls, the ledger, drift and revert
- [SIEM Interop](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/siem-interop.md): OCSF 1.3, SARIF 2.1 and Sigma export for SIEM/SOC pipelines
- [DFIR Interop](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/dfir-interop.md): import KAPE/Velociraptor/CyLR trees; export Timesketch JSONL and l2tcsv timelines
- [Product Packs](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR/blob/main/docs/product-packs.md): add a new AI agent product with one signed JSON file (detection + collector manifest + parser field map)
- [.adfir Package Spec](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/adfir-spec): the open evidence-package format
- [Event JSON Schema](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/schema/event.schema.json)
- [Finding JSON Schema](https://efij.github.io/AgentDFIR/schema/finding.schema.json)

## Facts

- License: MIT (free, open source)
- Language: Go, single static binary, zero third-party runtime dependencies in the collector core
- Evidence package format: .adfir (sealed, content-addressed, hash-chained custody, independently parseable)

## Optional

- [Repository](https://github.com/efij/AgentDFIR): source, issues, releases
